Frequently asked questions

SOAX has a Sandbox account, free to sign up with no credit card required. To use proxies, buy credits or upgrade to a paid plan.

SOAX covers 195+ countries with over 12 million residential and mobile IPs. Targeting goes down to city, state, and ASN level.

You control how rotation works. Rotate per request, after N requests, after a set time, or on error. If you need a sticky session, you can lock requests to a single node with no rotation.

We support HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5.

Card (instant), bank transfer (1-3 days), or crypto (after KYC). VAT is calculated at checkout based on your billing address and isn't included in the listed prices.
